scenarios.title: Empty successful output is formatted cleanly

obligations.requiredProof: production command exact empty-output metadata and exit assertion

testMechanism.negativeControl: Restore the grep-plus-fallback counter. The output must regain duplicate zero data or arithmetic diagnostics and fail the regression.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Evidence formatting is a command-line output contract.

scenarios.title: Empty failing output preserves the child exit

obligations.requiredProof: production command nonzero exit propagation and exact empty metadata assertion

testMechanism.negativeControl: Replace the exit-seven child with exit zero while retaining the expected wrapper exit. The propagation assertion must fail.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Child exit propagation is a command-line behavior.

obligations.requiredProof: production command one-line count and rendering assertion

testMechanism.negativeControl: Remove the child's only output line. The expected line count must change from one to zero.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Line counting is a command-line formatter contract.

scenarios.title: Missing capture output remains a distinct failure

testMechanism.negativeControl: Remove the capture-file existence check. The missing-path fixture must expose an empty or misleading evidence block.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Capture integrity is a command-line failure contract.
